final: WITH st AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS a FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(a) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS station_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM st) AS fraction FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage
